json_pointer_standard: RFC6901; ~0/~1 escaping, array ordinals, empty pointer denotes whole document

transformations.identity: Copy the original JSON value without rewording or changing type.
transformations.explicit_bool: Copy only an original JSON boolean; other types become UNKNOWN.
transformations.string_only: Copy the original string verbatim; null or absent remains null.
transformations.enum_bool: Map only the listed exact original categorical values; no substring or count inference.
transformations.nonnull_identity: Non-null exact original delivery identity is present; no body read, quality or native inference.
transformations.constant_bound: Fixed reporting/index choice, bound to the cited original index/config field.
transformations.unassessed_material_null: Original material count is retained separately; normalized count is null when original scientific grade is null.
transformations.all_explicit: Three-valued conjunction: false if an explicit component is false, true only if all components are explicitly true, otherwise UNKNOWN.
